skill.summary: Indonesian super app offering motorcycle taxis, food delivery, payments, and logistics, pioneering ojek digitization and multi-service integration.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the go-jek skill, version 1.0.0  
- Covers Gojek's history, business model, growth milestones, and unique strengths
